video_title: Marvin Harrison Jr. HAD to Leave Arizona to Save His Career

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Marvin Harrison Jr. needed a fresh start away from Arizona
quotes.excerpt: Anybody that go to Arizona, you going to die in Arizona.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: What have you been making of what you've been seeing of him?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Anybody that go to Arizona, you going to die in Arizona. I am not talking about because of the heat. I am talking about playing for the Cardinals. I do not know how Larry Fitzgerald managed to stay alive. Well, they gave him Kurt Warner for a handful of years. But even still, before and after, you are like, oh my God. With Marvin Harrison Jr. coming out of Ohio State, he comes out of there with such high praise because he can really play. But when you are stuck in a situation where they did not draft him, meaning the front office, they do not feel obligated to make sure that they cuddle him to a certain degree. He had to be mentally tough, and it seems like from an outsider he was not there where he needed to be. So the best thing for him is to find a new location to keep his career alive.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Marvin Harrison Jr. will be a different player in Houston
quotes.excerpt: When he touchdown in Houston, he going to be a different dude.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: So nothing to worry about in your opinion?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: No, not at all. He can catch. That is why they took him at the fourth pick of the draft. But when you are in a situation in a funk, you are going to miss shots, you are going to drop balls in a bad situation, especially when they are treating you wrong. I can only imagine when he is walking down the hallway, the coaches are probably looking at him sideways. I can almost guarantee you to a fault, when he touchdown in Houston, he going to be a different dude. Because now you got somebody in CJ Stroud who is going to wrap his arms around him. I am looking forward to him pairing him up with Nico Collins whenever they get Tank Dell back. That crew is going to be something special.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: How young players maintain mental toughness during losing streaks
quotes.excerpt: You just got to put in the back of your mind and remember how you got there.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Also speak to how hard is that on your mental? For younger guys, how hard is that mental to be able to, the world is down on me, how do I keep myself up?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: You got to fight through it. We are not all going to be successful immediately. We all have some sort of trials and tribulations that we have to overcome in the sport that we play. I do not care if it is catching the ball, getting jammed at the line of scrimmage, dropping balls, not scoring enough touchdowns. You just got to put in the back of your mind and remember how you got there. That is the way even when I was on bad teams, I just be like, I got to do what I need to do. If I do what I need to do, then I am going to outlast them anyway.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Evans' continued effectiveness at his age
quotes.excerpt: He was never a burner, but he was a long strider who can get over the top.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Let's move on to Mike Evans. Seven key receptions, six of them ended up being first downs, a touchdown. He played.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: First of all, he was never a burner, but he was a long strider who can get over the top. Now, that is not necessarily the case. So he is whooping your ass with his size. You cannot do nothing with it. And he is doing a lot of outside releases getting back inside. When I take an outside release and I stack you, and you are on my back, and I can feel you because I am much bigger than you, there is nothing you can do. It is a little bit of basketball positioning. If you look at the catch that Jeremiah Smith had last week against Iowa, he ran a dig route, which is an in-cut. He pushed up, it was three people around him, he climbed the ladder and went and got it. Those dudes are much smaller and not as wide as him, and he has got the length. That is like Mike Evans. You are a little guy. You are 5'11, to us, man, you are nothing.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The NFC West is the strongest division in the NFL
quotes.excerpt: NFC West is the strongest division top to bottom.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Is it the best division in the NFL, the NFC West? Is it the strongest, do you feel, top to bottom?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: NFC West is the strongest division top to bottom. Let me think real quick. Seattle, 49ers, Rams, Lamb Chops. Yeah, I would say so. Because I originally thought the AFC West would be with Denver, Kansas City, and then the Chargers. So I immediately felt like that was the case, but it really isn't. It is going to be three come out of the NFC West. I do not know if it is three coming out of any other division in the NFL other than that division.
